GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down 4th fence 3 Lengths 600m 5th 4 Lengths home turn 4th Middle Of Track held up final 100m Stewards: held up for clear running in the straight # honest/held up late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running in the straight and, as a result, was unable to be fully tested by its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Worked fwd & raced 4th 3 Wide No Cover (2.5L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & improving slowly 3 Wide from 600m. Pushed to quicken & laid out Five Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 200m. # Wide/stuck on OK
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Went Forward and sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, took over soon after Straightening Up but Ridden Along , Headed last 200m and faded final stages # on pace/faded 200m
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths rail turning, steered 3 Wide Straightening Up and moved from 5th to 2nd in Straight # winner far too good

jumped ok , Quickly Drifted Back Settled Down Clear last 8 Lengths @ 800m. Ridden Along to home Turn but not responding. essentially Eased down from top of Straight then Out Of Picture final 200 (vetted - nothing amiss) # hated the heavy
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated he was required to continually ride his mount along in the middle stages just to keep in touch with the field. Rdr stated as the field commenced to sprint rounding h/turn his mount quickly lost further ground & he did not test it down the straight when a beaten horse. Rdr stated mount was clearly not comfortable on the heavy track conditions & its form suggests such. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality. Trainer to restrict future starts to firmer going. On this assurance, no further action taken.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved marginally travelling 3 Wide in Straight # Had its chances
Jumped Ok went forward took sit 1-1 4len 600m up Hooked Out Straight Kept Going Too Well # every chance

Jumped evenly. Rolled fwd & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Four Wide in straight. # Poor from turn.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifted Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground to the line # wide, ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Shifted in under pressure approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back in second half rails 6 Lengths 800m, still well off them getting off fence Straightening Up , only one paced in Straight # never close
Jumped Well sat 1 length off 3 Wide No Cover , pushed Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, kept on fairly after tough run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.
